entities.title: Archer Queen
entities.summary: Ranged ground-and-air hero unlocked at Hero Hall 2 (TH8); 5-tile single-target attacks, Dark Elixir upgrades to level 110.

entities.title: Barbarian King
entities.summary: First Home Village hero: melee ground-only tank unlocked with Hero Hall 1 at TH4, upgraded with Dark Elixir from TH7 to level 110.

entities.title: Dragon Duke
entities.summary: Flying melee hero unlocked at Hero Hall 9 (TH15) with the Royal Rampage passive (double damage, +50% attack speed when no other air units are within 6 tiles); upgrades to level 25.

entities.title: Grand Warden
entities.summary: Elixir-upgraded support hero (Hero Hall 5, TH11) with air/ground modes, 7-tile single-target attacks, a 9-tile aura ring and Warden-weight group targeting.

entities.title: Minion Prince
entities.summary: Flying ranged hero unlocked at Hero Hall 3 (TH9); hits ground and air from 4.5 tiles, Dark Elixir upgrades to level 95.

entities.title: Royal Champion
entities.summary: Defense-targeting, wall-jumping spear thrower unlocked at Hero Hall 7 (TH13); 3-tile range, Dark Elixir upgrades to level 55.

entities.title: Action Figure
entities.summary: Queen Epic active item: summons one Giant Giant (level 1 → 10) and gives 1 s invisibility; passive DPS, HP and self-heal.

entities.title: Archer Puppet
entities.summary: Queen's starting active item: summons 5 → 35 invisible Archers at the player's Archer level; passive DPS and recovery.

entities.title: Frozen Arrow
entities.summary: Queen Epic passive item: every hit slows the target 25% → 65% for 0.75 → 3 s; passive DPS.

entities.title: Giant Arrow
entities.summary: Queen Common active item (Blacksmith 2): a piercing giant arrow aimed at an Air Defense that damages everything in a 1-tile-wide path across the village.

entities.title: Healer Puppet
entities.summary: Queen Common active item (Blacksmith 5): summons 1 → 3 Healers of fixed level 4 → 8; passive HP and self-healing.

entities.title: Invisibility Vial
entities.summary: Queen's starting active item: invisibility for 4.2 → 7.8 s with +340 → +1,740 damage per shot; passive HP.

entities.title: Magic Mirror
entities.summary: Queen Epic active item: summons 1 → 2 temporary Queen clones with fixed stats and makes her invisible for 1 s; passive HP and recovery.

entities.title: Monolith Arrow
entities.summary: Queen Epic passive item: attacks deal bonus damage equal to a % of the target's max HP (9.5% → 14%, reduced after 180 and 250 housing deployed) plus 3% → 10% damage reduction; passive HP.

entities.title: Barbarian Puppet
entities.summary: King's starting active item: summons raged Barbarians (8 → 44) at the player's Barbarian level; passive HP and recovery.

entities.title: Earthquake Boots
entities.summary: King Common active item (Blacksmith 1): 8-tile earthquake that destroys Walls and damages buildings (10% → 40% max HP) and ground troops; passive DPS/HP.

entities.title: Giant Gauntlet
entities.summary: King Epic active item: grows giant for 14 → 19 s with 2.5-tile splash attacks over Walls and 20% → 60% damage reduction; passive DPS and self-heal.

entities.title: Rage Vial
entities.summary: King's starting active item: 10-second self-rage (+120% → +155% damage, large move-speed boost) with big recovery; passive DPS.

entities.title: Snake Bracelet
entities.summary: King Epic passive item: spawns wall-jumping Snakes for every 300 damage he takes (cap 11 → 54); passive DPS, HP and attack speed.

entities.title: Spiky Ball
entities.summary: King Epic active item: kicks a ricocheting ball that hits 2 → 8 different buildings for 1,000 → 3,250 each; passive DPS and HP.

entities.title: Stick Horse
entities.summary: King Epic passive item: on deployment grants 12 → 30 s of wall jumping with faster movement and attacks; passive DPS and HP.

entities.title: Vampstache
entities.summary: King Common passive item (Blacksmith 3): heals a flat amount on every hit (60 → 300); passive DPS and attack speed.

entities.title: Electro Fangs
entities.summary: Duke Common passive item (Blacksmith 10): his attacks chain lightning to 1 → 4 extra nearby targets (330 → 400 damage, −20% per jump); passive HP.

entities.title: Fire Heart
entities.summary: Duke's starting passive item: a one-time 4-tile death explosion (1,000 → 3,000) and strong self-regeneration; passive DPS and HP.

entities.title: Flame Blower
entities.summary: Duke's starting active item: a 12-tile, 60° cone of fire dealing 1,300 → 2,500 damage, with added recovery; passive HP.

entities.title: Revenge Deck
entities.summary: Duke Epic passive item: counter-attacks anything that damages him with a card (150 → 225 damage) and heals 30 → 60 per counter, max once per 0.8 s per attacker; passive HP.

entities.title: Rocket Backpack
entities.summary: Duke Epic active item: an untargetable dash in a straight line through the village centre to the far edge, flaming everything on the path (575 → 2,150); passive DPS, HP and recovery.

entities.title: Stun Blaster
entities.summary: Duke Common active item (Blacksmith 9): an 8-tile shockwave that damages (150 → 400) and stuns defenses and defending troops for 4.5 → 7.5 s; passive DPS, HP and recovery.

entities.title: Eternal Tome
entities.summary: Warden's starting active item: makes himself and all friendly units in his ring invincible for 3.2 → 8.2 s; no passive boosts.

entities.title: Fireball
entities.summary: Warden Epic active item: a fireball at the nearest defense (any range) dealing 1,500 → 4,100 splash damage in a 4 → 6 tile radius; passive DPS.

entities.title: Healing Tome
entities.summary: Warden Common active item (Blacksmith 6): a 15 → 20 s healing aura that follows him and heals allies (heroes at full rate) 60 → 150 HP/s; passive HP and recovery.

entities.title: Heroic Torch
entities.summary: Warden Epic active item: for 16 → 27.5 s allies in his ring move faster, take 6% → 15% less damage and can pass through Walls; passive DPS, HP and recovery.

entities.title: Lavaloon Puppet
entities.summary: Warden Epic active item: summons 1 → 3 weakened Lavaloons (level 1 → 11) that hunt Air Defenses, bomb as they fly and burst into pups; passive DPS and HP.

entities.title: Life Gem
entities.summary: Warden's starting passive item: aura giving nearby allies +50% → +120% extra HP up to a 640 → 1,200 cap; passive DPS and HP.

entities.title: Rage Gem
entities.summary: Warden Common passive item (Blacksmith 4): aura raising allies' damage (or healing) by 15% → 50% without speed boosts; passive DPS and attack speed.

entities.title: Dark Crown
entities.summary: Prince Epic passive item: gains up to three stacking-tier buffs (+10/20/30% HP and damage at max) as 60/120/180 housing of his allies die; passive HP and attack speed.

entities.title: Dark Orb
entities.summary: Prince's starting active item: a slow-moving dark orb that damages and slows everything within 5 tiles along its path; passive DPS and HP.

entities.title: Henchmen Puppet
entities.summary: Prince's starting active item: summons two flying Henchmen (level 1 → 7) and 1 s invisibility; passive DPS, flat +500 HP and recovery.

entities.title: Metal Pants
entities.summary: Prince Common active item (Blacksmith 3): 9 → 15 s shield reducing all damage by 46% → 70%, with large recovery; passive HP.

entities.title: Meteor Staff
entities.summary: Prince Epic passive item: every 10 → 5 s a meteor hits the nearest defense at any distance for 250 → 850 area damage; passive DPS and HP.

entities.title: Noble Iron
entities.summary: Prince Common passive item (Blacksmith 5): his first 5 → 10 shots after deployment reach 10 → 12 tiles and deal +350 → +770 damage; passive attack speed and flat +500 HP.

entities.title: Electro Boots
entities.summary: Champion Epic passive item: a permanent electric aura hitting nearby enemies every 0.4 s (132 → 200 DPS); passive HP and self-heal.

entities.title: Frost Flake
entities.summary: Champion Epic active item: fires 4 → 7 ice flakes at separate nearby defenses, each dealing small damage and freezing the target for 5.2 → 7 s; passive HP.

entities.title: Haste Vial
entities.summary: Champion Common active item (Blacksmith 8): 7 → 10 s of +60% → +100% attack speed and a big movement boost; passive DPS and attack speed.

entities.title: Hog Rider Puppet
entities.summary: Champion Common active item (Blacksmith 7): summons 8 → 10 Hog Riders of fixed level 5 → 12 and 1 s invisibility; passive HP and recovery.

entities.title: Rocket Spear
entities.summary: Champion Epic active item: her next 7 → 10 throws become 10-tile rocket spears at the closest defense with +350 → +980 damage and small splash; passive DPS and HP.

entities.title: Royal Gem
entities.summary: Champion's starting active item: adds 1,200 → 2,400 recovery to her ability; passive DPS and HP.

entities.title: Seeking Shield
entities.summary: Champion's starting active item: a thrown shield that hits four different targets anywhere on the map (defenses first) for 1,000 → 2,500 each; passive HP.

entities.title: Angry Jelly
entities.summary: Pet House 10 flying pet that brainwashes its hero into defense-targeting for 25 → 35 s while riding above it untargetable.

entities.title: Diggy
entities.summary: Pet House 6 burrowing pet that bypasses Walls and stuns defenses when it surfaces next to them.

entities.title: Electro Owl
entities.summary: Pet House 2 flying pet that shoots chain lightning (two targets, −20% on the second) at its hero's target.

entities.title: Frosty
entities.summary: Pet House 5 ranged pet whose hits chill targets and who spawns wall-jumping, defense-hunting Frostmites every 8 s.

entities.title: Greedy Raven
entities.summary: Pet House 12 flying pet that pelts resource buildings near its hero with rapid feathers for 5× damage.

entities.title: L.A.S.S.I
entities.summary: Pet House 1 ground melee pet that stays close to its hero and jumps over Walls (High Jumper).

entities.title: Mighty Yak
entities.summary: Pet House 3 high-HP ground pet dealing 20× damage to Walls; rages for 8 s when its hero is knocked out.

entities.title: Phoenix
entities.summary: Pet House 8 pet that waits as an invulnerable egg, revives its hero once with 6.5 → 8.5 s of invincibility, then fights as a splash-damage air unit.

entities.title: Poison Lizard
entities.summary: Pet House 7 fast-spitting ranged pet that prefers heroes/troops and poisons them (slow, attack-rate cut, damage over time).

entities.title: Sneezy
entities.summary: Pet House 11 flying pet that keeps its distance and sneezes out Boogers (max 2), turning into an enraged short-range defense attacker when its hero falls.

entities.title: Spirit Fox
entities.summary: Pet House 9 ground pet that repeatedly turns itself and its hero invisible (3 → 4 s, then a 6 s gap).

entities.title: Unicorn
entities.summary: Pet House 4 healer pet that heals its hero (ground or air) every second at full rate.

entities.title: Blacksmith
entities.summary: 3x3 building (TH8+) that stores ore and instantly upgrades hero equipment; its level caps equipment levels (Common 9→18, Epic 12→27) and unlocks Common equipment.

entities.title: Hero Banner
entities.summary: 2x2 untargetable defensive post: each banner holds one defending hero; banners come from Hero Hall slots (1/2/3/4 at TH7/9/11/13).

entities.title: Hero Bell
entities.summary: Crafted (seasonal) defense whose 50-tile aura raises defending heroes' damage and hitpoints until it is destroyed; three 10-level modules.

entities.title: Hero Hall
entities.summary: 4x4 army building (TH4+) that unlocks heroes, sets hero level caps and hero slots (1/2/3/4 at levels 1/3/5/7), hosts hero upgrades, skins and Hero's Journey.

entities.title: Pet House
entities.summary: 3x3 army building (TH14+) that unlocks one new pet per level (12 levels) and researches pet upgrades with Dark Elixir, one at a time.

entities.title: Hero Equipment
entities.summary: Hub page: 42 Home Village equipment items (8 BK, 8 AQ, 6 MP, 7 GW, 7 RC, 6 DD), active vs passive, rarity, history and the 2023 migration table.

entities.title: Hero's Journey
entities.summary: TH7+ Hero Hall reward track driven by cumulative Home Village hero levels, with hero quests, Epic equipment rewards and TH-scaled Ore Chests.

entities.title: Heroes
entities.summary: Hub page: six Home Village heroes (plus two Builder Base heroes); cross-page hero rules for slots, abilities, equipment, defense and early-TH scaling.

entities.title: Ore Calculations
entities.summary: Community (user-written) calculation page: relative ore values from war/Star Bonus/gem/medal prices and cumulative equipment costs; not official data.

entities.title: Ores
entities.summary: Shiny, Glowy and Starry Ore: Blacksmith-only currencies earned from Star Bonus, Clan Wars, Hero's Journey, Trader and offers; capped by Blacksmith level.

entities.title: Pets
entities.summary: Hub page: twelve Pet House pets that accompany a hero on attack; immortal between battles, one per hero, never defend.

entities.title: Prospector
entities.summary: TH10 Helper (Gold Pass CPoints) who converts up to 2,000 Shiny / 120 Glowy / 2 Starry Ore into another ore type once per helper work day.

entities.title: Troop Movement Speed
entities.summary: Reference for converting internal speed values (tiles/s × 100) to the wiki's in-game speed numbers (internal ÷ 12.5); hero and pet rows only are relevant here.
